description:
The El Legs Express features a powerful 36v 350w mid drive motor with up 648 watts of motor output, paired with our in-frame 36v9.6ah Panasonic battery.
Lightweight, hydro-formed tubing is used to significantly reduce weight, benefiting steering and adding structure to the Express design. Mid Drive propulsion keeps weight under the rider and allows for easy wheel customization and maintenance. The result is an electric bicycle that is as light as it looks and is structurally stiff for a well-handling, responsive smooth ride.With stock fenders and chain guard to keep you clean, and bottle and rack bosses, the commuter friendly and trail capable Express is ready to get you out and on the move!
Lightweight and Low Profile
The streamlined frame design is one of the lightest electric bicycles on the market. The Express steers and looks like a regular bicycle and will travel wherever you point it. Internal cable routing keeps the look clean from all angles.
Low Center of Gravity
A comfortable ride and superior handling comes from proper weight placement. Strong, light wheels, mid mounted motor and a battery mounted under the rider giving you comfort and unmatched handling at cruising speed and around turns.
Smooth pedal assist and throttle
The 9-level assist system detects your forces against the pedal and multiples your power through the cadence and speed sensing mid drive motor. There is no need to control a throttle, all electronics function at the push of a button. Riders can simply pedal, concentrate and enjoy the ride while sensing the motor performance or use the thumb throttle to cruise down any path.
Panasonic battery cells rated for high power and long life
The El Legs Express demands powerful advanced lithium-ion chemistry to go fast and power through any condition. With an on-board battery management system (BMS) for superior performance and long life, these lightweight, high capacity battery packs, BMS and chargers ensure a long lasting and reliable source of power.
Bright integrated LED headlights
Light up your path and let others know you are there so you can safely ride at night.
Frame
6160 aluminum alloy is used exclusively on Volton Bicycles. A tough, durable, light alloy, 6160 aluminum alloy delivers fantastic, reliable performance that lasts for thousands of miles. It is, by far, the ultimate aluminum tubing that stands up to the powerful Volton El Legs Express.
